newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fairfax names new Sun-Herald editor.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fairfax names new Sun-Herald editor.

text.p: John Fairfax Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that Alan Revell had been appointed editor of The Sun-Herald, the company's Sunday paper in Sydney.
Fairfax chief executive Robert Muscat said the appointment followed the resignation of current editor Andrew Clark.
"Mr Clark has decided to pursue other interests outside John Fairfax," Muscat said.
Clark was editor of The Sun-Herald for four years. Revell, 39, is a former deputy editor of The Courier Mail in Brisbane.
He takes up his new appointment on February 10.
